_default.note: Used where a country value is missing; documented as an app assumption

DE.note: Hot water 12.5 kWh/(m2.a) per A_N: GModG § 20 Abs. 2. Internal gains 45 Wh/(m2.d) = 1.875 W/m2: DIN V 18599-10 single-family (paid standard; secondary)

IE.note: DEAP 4.2.7: 21 C living area / 18 C rest, 56 h/week; occupancy N(TFA) formula official. Gains and hot water depend on N inside the DEAP software; the app keeps its EN default

DK.note: SBi 213 dwelling defaults: persons 1.5 W/m2 + equipment incl. lighting 3.5 W/m2 (min 90 / 210 W per home), hot water 250 L/(m2.a). SBi 213 itself is paid; values from the industry guide

FI.note: Decree 1010/2017 class 1 (small residential): §10 outdoor air 0.4 dm3/(s.m2), heating limit 21 C; §11 lighting 6 / appliances 3 / people 2 W/m2 with usage 0.1 / 0.6 / 0.6; §12 hot water 35 kWh/(m2.a), at most 4200 kWh per dwelling

SK.status: official (air change) / default (gains, hot water, setpoint)

BE-BRU.note: Brussels certificate: 18 C mean in all rooms, 365 days; hot water scales with home size (about 150 L/day for 170 m2)

HR.status: official (setpoint, gains, air change) / default (hot water)
HR.note: Algoritam HRN EN 13790 (2021): Tablica 1.1 family houses 20 C heating; 1.3.3.1 internal gains 5 W/m2 of A_K for residential; minimum n_inf + n_win 0.5 /h without mechanical ventilation (read 2026-11-16)

BE-WAL.note: AGW PEB 2026 Annexe A1 (PER): 18 C constant (5.x); internal gains 7.9.2 eq. 50: 0.67 V + 220 W (V > 192 m3), 1.41 V + 78 W below; hot water net need eq. 18: one bath (64 + 0.220 (V-192) W) + one kitchen sink (16 + 0.055 (V-192) W), minimum at 192 m3; V = protected volume. Ventilation equations are images: default kept (read 2026-11-16)

ES.note: CTE DB-HE Anejo D: heating 20 C 7:00-23:00 and 17 C at night (time average 19 C); tabla b: sensible occupancy + lighting + equipment, weekly average 4.81 W/m2. Hot water is 28 L/person/day at 60 C with persons by bedrooms (Anejo F) - the app has no bedrooms, so the default per m2 is kept (read 2026-11-16)
